T = 4k² / [k²(A+D)² + (k²B − C)²],

where M = M_b2·M_well·M_b1 = [[A, B], [C, D]]. This reduces to T = 1 for free space and to the standard single-barrier result T = 1/(1 + V²sinh²(κb)/(4E(V−E))), so it is consistent.
